prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: You know it well (a)/ that your success in life (b)/ depends not on my advice but on somebody's else, (c)/ no error (d)

explanation: With 'somebody else' the possessive 's goes at the end of the whole phrase, so "somebody's else" must be "somebody else's".
